text: I was in acute pain in my spine from a agressive cough, my spine alignment looks way off and the doctor miraculously fixed it like a whisperer. Simply mesmerised by his skills and knowledge. Highly recommended!

We arrived with severe lower back pain radiating down our legs. The vertebrologist rubbed my skin through my clothing with his fingers (and my neck for some reason) and sent me for a cold compress and electrical stimulation. The "help" was ineffective. He also recommended buying a lumbar support from them. The assistant spent a long time choosing the right size and then recommended one that turned out to be uncomfortable. I don't recommend it.
